fact: New Vision reports EMIS was rolled out in July 2022 to replace the Annual School Census, collects data from schools nationwide, and the Ministry uses its data to determine capitation grants, with registration mandatory for all schools.
New Vision reports that under EMIS every learner is assigned a unique Learner Identification Number (LIN), with registration mandatory for all schools nationwide.
The brief says the national EMIS, adopted in 1993, collects and aggregates enrollment, teacher and infrastructure data, and the Annual School Census was most recently run in 2025.
The brief says the DHIS2-Ed system was linked to the Ministry of Health's eIDSR platform for school-based surveillance indicators and collates examination data.
Uganda's education ministry relaunched and rolled out its EMIS in 2022, and it issues learners a Learner Identification Number through the system.
Learners are assigned Learner Identification Numbers by the Ministry of Education through the EMIS system, per the document.
IDRC reports that the District Health Information System platform has recently been tried with success in Uganda to address the lack of an education management information system.
system: DHIS2 for education (District Health Information System platform)
